verified_text_findings.age_child: Body shape and regular colour gradually approach the favoured first evolution; identity is selected at cocoon entry.
verified_text_findings.age_adult: Mutable after evolution; based on animals/drives and aging, no fixed age and not visible stats. Opposing pairs can reverse the secondary.
verified_text_findings.hero_run_young: Blue/yellow hand markings, blue/purple stomach markings, small straight spike, yellow halo.
verified_text_findings.hero_run_aged_normal: Long spike, blue markings and stripy blue hands.
verified_text_findings.hero_run_aged_run: Light blue markings; head splits into three petal-like parts.
verified_text_findings.evolution_original_rule: The linked Info Center says highest visible stat and Stamina-to-Normal are false descriptions of the original rule; recent hidden animal/drive interaction determines the original type.
verified_text_findings.prototype_override: Four-stat highest-points/latest-increase first selection and current-bar reversible specialization are user-requested Minecraft policies, not exact original-game algorithms.
